answer: A glacier of staking collateral forms a knoll of validator commitments: each node posts s_i, so Sybil cost c(k)=sum(s_i)+q*k^2, making marginal attack cost 2*q*k outpace extracted value V(k)<=a*k since 2*q*k-a>0. Quadratic slashing imposes penalty p(k)=b*k^2-g*k, while zero-knowledge verifiable delay ties each vote to a mesa of irreversible work, so extra identities erode more capital than they gain. With E[U]=V-c-p<0, the robust Nash equilibrium is honest attestation.
